summary: Focused retest of the MEDIUM issue from iteration_43 (floor-plan schedule hanging below the plan at ≤1024). The new @media (max-width:1100px) block in scripts/tac_overrides.css resolves it. At 1440 and 1920 the schedule bottom is exactly aligned with the plan image bottom (delta 0.00px) in a true two-column layout; at 1024/768/430/390 the section correctly stacks with the plan image above the schedule and no dangling rows. All quick-regression checks pass.

detailed_results.footnote_position: Below plan body at all widths

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and well-scoped — the @media (max-width:1100px) override only relaxes the flex-1 stretch behaviour used for desktop bottom-alignment, so wide-desktop parity is preserved.
